title: Local Speech Service
status.label: Service status
btn.restartHint: Restart: stop then start the service (needed after changing the model or updating server code)
msg.modelSaved: Model selection saved; it applies at the next start
msg.backendSaved: Backend selection saved; it applies at the next start
hint.backendNone: No usable inference backend (both GPU and CPU failed).
hint.backendUnknown: Backend info unavailable (service not running, or an older build).
hint.custom: Any ggml model URL (.bin). It appears in the Active model dropdown once downloaded.
hint.modelPick: Switching the model restarts the service; while stopped the choice is only saved.
hint.modelEmpty: Start the service to pick an installed ggml model here.
hint.catalogOffline: Start the service to download models here.
hint.modelNote: Models are saved under whisper/ in the service directory. When the proxy field is blank, Snow App's own proxy setting is used automatically.
hint.dir: Directory containing stt_server.py (the whisper runtime lives in its whisper/ subfolder).
hint.blocked: The plugin could not reach the loopback endpoint. Check whether the app build allows local HTTP requests from plugins.
hint.start: Start runs python stt_server.py in the background; a resident whisper-server is launched on demand so the model is loaded only once.
note.title: About
note.body: This panel controls the local whisper.cpp service that snow-voice-io uses for speech-to-text. Speech recognition itself runs entirely on this machine.
